children: China's imports of iron ore in August rose 0.4% from the prior month and gained 3.1% from the year before, customs data showed on Tuesday.
The world's largest iron ore consumer brought in 108.54 million metric tons of the key steelmaking ingredient last month, data from the country's General Administration of Customs showed.
In the first eight months of 2026, China's iron ore imports totalled 845.27 million tons, an annual rise of 5.5%, according to the data.
